subject.title: [Bug] Dashboard Stop button can corrupt session files + agent permission isolation lacks guardrails

question: Should OpenClaw split #91440 into Stop/session durability and host-exec isolation, and what default host-exec posture should existing users get?
rationale: The Stop fix is session-durability work, while cross-agent host-exec isolation changes the documented trusted-operator security boundary and may affect existing workflows.

options.title: Split and sponsor both tracks
options.body: Keep #91440 open as the umbrella, land/prove Stop drain or recovery first, and drive host-exec isolation through an explicit compatible policy or doctor-guided migration.

options.title: Keep only the Stop bug here
options.body: Treat full/off host exec as documented trusted-operator behavior and move per-agent isolation to #78096/#78965 while this issue tracks only session corruption.

options.title: Make host exec strict by default
options.body: Adopt a stricter default approval/isolation stance, but require migration, docs, and upgrade proof before shipping it.

recommendation.title: Split and sponsor both tracks
recommendation.body: Keep #91440 open as the umbrella, land/prove Stop drain or recovery first, and drive host-exec isolation through an explicit compatible policy or doctor-guided migration.

likelyOwner.reason: He is tied to current central files and to the adjacent per-agent filesystem capability design thread.
